answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks through token-based reputation staking where each agent must lock valuable computational resources. Like an ocean of mutual vouching, agents only interact after verifying identity through proof-of-work contracts. The system assigns an onyx-black reputation score that grows through sustained contributions, making counterfeit personas prohibitively expensive. Each fake agent must replicate not just credentials but the entire sonnet of verified history, rendering mass impersonation economically unfeasible.
